prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Mara firekeeper model turnaround: horizontal 3:1 sheet, three equal square cells front, side facing RIGHT, back. Identical scale all views. Sturdy 2.5-head-tall survivor, height 78% cell, soles 95% cell height. Neutral straight arms hanging, mittens at hip, straight legs. Ochre #c98a2b knitted beanie with two cream #d9cdb8 stripes, earflaps with ties, bobble. NO HOOD. Thick auburn #8a3f22 braid over near shoulder in three chunky segments. Medium brown #c68863 skin, dark oval dot eyes, tiny nose, confident half-smile, one raised brow, flat soot smudge on cheek. Moss #56603e hip-length parka cream scalloped fur cuffs and hem. Sooty leather apron #6b4a2f chest to hem, single pocket holding two tongs handles. Teal scarf #2f7f7a, dark grey trousers #4a4a4f visible below coat, brown lace-up boots. Flat clean shapes, sparse detail. No tools in hands. Transparent background. Final delivery 960x320, generate larger.
